name: gf_escape
what: isolated CNS: giant-fibre spike to jump (TTMn) and flight (DLMn) motor neuron latency, plus the conduction delay to the muscle, against the measured latencies (the neural proxy for the escape take-off; the jump itself is not scored)

harness.note: the brain as flyemu.organism.Organism builds it (with the body, which is not stepped), as scripts/probes/gf_latency.py does; one network seeded default_rng(seed); noise per profile; no sensory drive. Gap junctions at the model default (electrical:all|gap_conductance 0, not adopted)

readout.note: per kick: the first GF spike within 2 steps of the kick; per motor neuron cell, its first spike in the 10 ms after it (central latency); muscle latency = central + the type's delay_ms (axon length / inferred velocity + 0.5 ms neuromuscular, inferred). Control windows half a period later, with no kick, give the chance rate

reference.source: Augustin et al. 2017 PLoS Biol 15:e2001655 S1 Table, WT, brain stimulation through the eyes, stimulus artifact to muscle EPSP onset, mean ms (measured)
reference.band: young mean - 2 SEM (rounded to 0.001 ms) to old mean

bar_source: scripts/probes/gf_latency.py verdict (TTM_in_band, TTM_follow_ge_0.9, DLM_in_band; s13 N12/N18 pre-registration, DECISIONS)
evidence_status: spent: Augustin 2017 latencies were scored in s13 to s21 (F-GJ-6, F-GJ-7), so this is a regression check, not held-out evidence
